about.text: A protected white brined cheese of Messinia and Laconia in the southern Peloponnese, semi-hard, salty and piquant as it ripens. The curd is sliced, drained and pressed, dry-salted and kept in brine for a month at room temperature, then at 4 to 6 °C for at least three months.
